item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02200","case1_error":"Multiplies area by coverage, then divides by coverage, incorrectly treating the resulting area as gallons.","case2_error":"No mathematical error: each tile covers 6 square inches, so 3456 ÷ 6 = 576 tiles.","reason":"Case 2 correctly follows the question; its reference incorrectly treats tile area as side length.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02201","case1_error":"Invents an initial zero inventory and uses inconsistent cookie balances, ignoring returned cookies and the half-missing constraint.","case2_error":"Counts the cupcakes Sarah gives away as cupcakes she retains, adding 3 instead of 6 to her five cookies.","reason":"Case 1 fabricates inventory and inconsistent balances; case 2 substitutes the transferred portion for the retained portion.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02202","case1_error":"After correct group-product formulas, introduces unsupported totals and an extra 64 contribution, producing 112.","case2_error":"Reports the brother's 11 cars as the three-person total, omitting Tommy's and Jessie's six cars.","reason":"Unsupported contributions after correct formulas differ from reporting a correctly calculated subgroup quantity as the requested total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02203","case1_error":"Uses one Monday count instead of Tuesday's two tile counts, yielding four; this fails under either counting-unit interpretation.","case2_error":"Reports only the return-trip animal count, omitting the 60 morning sightings from the day's total.","reason":"Case 1 substitutes an out-of-period count for an applicable count; case 2 omits an entire applicable period.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02204","case1_error":"Adds costs for 14 individual balloons and two ten-packs, pricing 34 balloons instead of the required 14.","case2_error":"Includes an incorrect apples-to-adults relation, then gives unsupported 110 after the correct final formula, which yields 40.","reason":"Case 1 combines redundant purchase quantities; case 2 has an erroneous intermediate relation and an unsupported answer after a correct formula.","judgment":"different"}]}
